plugins.name: gradle-skills
plugins.description: Skills for working with Gradle projects.

plugins.name: roadmap-skills
plugins.description: Skills for driving a repo's roadmap: claim the next item and build it, for repos you own or upstream OSS projects you contribute to via a fork.

plugins.name: session-skills
plugins.description: Place and lease for a repo worked by several sessions at once: adopt or open a worktree, claim a lane in a shared ledger, land the work by what the repo actually is rather than by a declared mode, and conduct several lanes at once when a run has nobody watching it.

plugins.name: communication-skills
plugins.description: Writes to you in plain language a cold reader can follow, writes as you when the text ships under your name, and stops to ask before decisions you cannot undo.

plugins.name: orchestration-skills
plugins.description: Hands work to other agents without losing control of it: what is worth delegating, what every brief must carry, which agents worktree isolation breaks, which tier each stage runs at, and how to tell a finished stage from one that merely stopped talking.
